description: Form accessibility + responsive collapse on AIToolPage. The shared form previously used grid-cols-2 with no breakpoint, marked required fields only with a visual asterisk, and never linked field hints via aria-describedby. On submit, the toast listed missing fields but didn't move keyboard focus to the first one. This change fixes all four issues.
steps: Change the form grid from grid-cols-2 to grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2; full-span fields use sm:col-span-2.
Render id='hint-{field.id}' on each hint paragraph and aria-describedby on the matching input.
Capture refs to every input via fieldRefs.current[field.id] and focus the first missing required field on a failed submit.
Mark the visual red asterisk as aria-hidden so it is not double-announced.
acceptance_criteria: Single-column on phones, two-column from sm: breakpoint upward.
Screen readers announce required state via aria-required (no reliance on the visual *).
Hints are read as part of the input description.
Failed submits move focus to the first missing required field.
verification: Manual: keyboard-only walkthrough; screen reader on iOS Safari.
findings: All AIToolPage tools inherit the fix automatically — no per-tool changes were required.
